objective: Complete Prof. Mo's requested reproduction and additional-potential evaluation, and prepare reviewable results and a draft message.
additional_model: MACE-OMAT-0 Small (distinct checkpoint from the included MACE-MPA-0 medium)
deliverables: A concise scientific report with methods, coverage, metric tables, reproduction discrepancies and limitations
Machine-readable tables and standardized results, with a manifest linking retained raw results and checksums
Reproduction commands, dependency versions, model sources and checkpoint hashes
An unsent draft reply to Prof. Mo summarizing the verified findings
fidelity: Use supplied DFT reference data and unchanged upstream metric definitions
Keep static and full-relaxation protocols separate
Retain non-converged trajectories and calculation failures; investigate failures rather than silently dropping inputs
Document all observed deviations from published results and validated execution adaptations
Do not claim unseen-data performance or absence of training overlap without evidence

optional_not_required.dft_static_on_fp_neb: The upstream NEB README explicitly marks this diagnostic optional. No new VASP calculations are required to complete the email request.
optional_not_required.other_reference_functionals: This run evaluates the supplied PBE and OMat24 populations; MatPES-r2SCAN is not a functional-matched benchmark for these selected checkpoints.

communications: Prepare a draft only. Do not send email or publish results without explicit user authorization.
